docs.usage_constraints: This operation activates the TLS account and writes account state. Do not retry automatically after an ambiguous failure; call account.get first to reconcile the current status.

BeginRegex.description: Regular expression that identifies the first line of a multiline log. Pass an empty string when only LogRegex is used.

LogRegex.description: Regular expression that matches and extracts the complete log. Pass an empty string when only BeginRegex is used.

LogSample.description: Log sample to validate. A non-empty BeginRegex requires a multiline sample.

docs.usage_constraints: BeginRegex and LogRegex keys are both required, and at least one value must be non-empty. This is a non-persistent validation operation.

LogSample.description: Single-line log sample used to generate a beginning-line regular expression.

docs.usage_constraints: This is a non-persistent configuration helper. Validate the generated expression with representative samples before saving a collector rule.

End.description: Comma-separated exclusive end offsets paired with Start.

LogSample.description: Log sample used to generate the extraction regular expression.

Multiline.description: Whether LogSample represents a multiline log.

Start.description: Comma-separated inclusive start offsets paired with End. Each pair selects a [start,end) substring.

docs.usage_constraints: Start and End must contain the same number of ordered, non-overlapping offsets within LogSample. This operation does not persist the generated expression.

PathSample.description: Absolute path sample. Wildcards '*', '?' and '**' are not allowed.

Regex.description: Valid regular expression whose capture groups extract values from PathSample.

docs.usage_constraints: PathSample must be absolute and contain no wildcard characters. This is a non-persistent validation operation.

EnableNanosecond.description: Return a nanosecond timestamp when true; otherwise return milliseconds.

TimeFormat.description: strptime-compatible format used to parse TimeSample.

TimeZone.description: Timezone such as Local, Etc/GMT+12, or GMT-12:00.

docs.usage_constraints: Timestamp units depend on EnableNanosecond: true returns nanoseconds and false returns milliseconds. No configuration is persisted.

Quote.description: Optional quote marker. Content enclosed by this marker is not split.

docs.usage_constraints: If Quote is present it must be non-empty and must not occur in Delimiter. This is a non-persistent validation operation.

topicId.description: TLS topic ID. The wire field intentionally uses lower camel case.

docs.usage_constraints: This operation reads the latest available log sample for a topic. Treat returned log fields as potentially sensitive.

delimiter.description: Full-text index delimiters. Escape special characters as required by TLS.

log.description: Example log used for the delimiter preview.

topicId.description: TLS topic ID. The wire field intentionally uses lower camel case.

docs.usage_constraints: This operation validates topic ownership and invokes the backend analyzer, but does not persist index configuration. Limit retries for transient backend failures.

DSLContent.description: Processor DSL or SPL content to validate against LogSample.

ExecAction.description: Execution action. The backend currently accepts only debug.

LogSample.description: Example log object passed to the processor debugger.

ProcessorDSLType.description: Processor language. This field is required by backend Validate even though the generated Swagger omits it from required.

docs.usage_constraints: This operation compiles and runs a processor against a sample without persisting processor state. Inspect ExecStatus even when HTTP status is 200; failed executions return ExecStatus=failed with Error.

Bucket.description:
对象存储桶名称。
- 只能包含数字、横线（-）、字母a-z。
- 开始和结尾只能是数字或字母。
- 长度在3-63个字符之内。

Endpoint.description: 代理集群接入目标域名，对外api不暴露此参数

Interval.description: 投递时间间隔，单位为秒，取值范围为300-900。

PartitionFormat.description:
投递日志的分区规则。
- 参考c语言的strftime函数对于format参数的说明：https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man3/strptime.3.html
- 不能以正斜线（/）或者反斜线（\）开头

Prefix.description:
投递对象存储桶中的前缀目录。
- 不能以正斜线（/）或者反斜线（\）开头，且不能使用连续的正斜线（/）。
- 不能以..作为文件夹名称。
- 同一存储桶中，文件夹不允许重名。
